Subject: Renewal QBR: rotating 15-minute micro-demos & runbook

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. For the Renewal QBR and roadmap demo next month, we wanted to propose a slightly different format to accommodate your execs' tight calendars: a sequence of rotating 15-minute micro-demos (30–45 minute total for your core stakeholders) where we run focused, role-specific walk-throughs back-to-back. Benefits: shorter commitments for each stakeholder, easier recording for asynchronously shared highlights, and cleaner skip/fallback for attendees who need to drop in/out.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Dec 6, 8:00–9:00 AM (three 15-min demos + buffer)
- Option B: Dec 7, 10:30–11:30 AM
- Option C: Dec 8, 2:00–3:00 PM

What we need from you to lock things in:
1) Which window best aligns with exec availability
2) A short list of attendee roles for each 15-min slot (e.g., product exec / procurement / SRE)
3) Any recording/NDAs/concerns for distribution

Attached: proposed-15min-agenda.pdf and a quick calendar-poll link (calendar-poll-link.txt). If those three options don't work, tell us preferred blocks and we'll slice accordingly.

Next steps: if you approve a window we'll send a runbook and calendar invites; we'll also include a brief 1‑page pre-read.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Partner, Redwood Inference
